made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/calendario-sheet-make.js, from calendario-set.html (window.CALENDARIO.E and colU) and the design of El calendario (the orchestrator's p6-spec, section calendario). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 120. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is laid out square to the picture: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), the board's face at v 0; plaza-base.js PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 120 + 13 v - 22.5 z. Column k's middle is c(k) = colU(k) + cw / 2 (cw 0.68): c1 -2.1, c2 -1.42, c3 -0.74, c4 -0.06, c5 0.62, c6 1.3, c7 1.98; the picture holds u from -4.62 to 4.62
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the paving; z 0.3: the step's top; z 0.46: the seat's top) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). A small thing has a box (the spot's box): a card on a hook hangs with its top row on sy and its middle on sx; the sun peg is centred on its spot; the balloons, the kite, the bows and the box of cards have their bottom middle on the spot; the card held up at muestra has the middle of its left edge on the spot (it is held out to her right). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 53 rows drawn standing for a grown-up (a 56-row canvas whose lowest row is empty), 41 for a child; the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); abuela sitting mkAbuelaS (52 x 50): column 17 (her middle) and row 36 (her lap) on (sx, sy), the spot being the seat; a grown-up sitting (mkPersona with sent = 1): column 24 and the lap row, the bottom of the hips: row 16 + 2 t + 3 (t 11 a grown-up: 41) on (sx, sy); Canelo lying mkPerro('lie') (30 x 22): column 15 and its bottom edge; a small thing: see spot. Whoever sits on the seat faces left: no sprite is turned (the makers draw them from the front)
rules.view: one window, wide, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture, x0 = its left edge (22 centres it). Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character
rules.cards: a card (14 x 12) on gancho.k.j hangs with its top at the hook: its box is [sx - 7, sy, 14, 12] (the hooks are 14.4 px apart down the column, a column is 17.68 px wide); a card on arco_gancho hangs the same way under the hoop
rules.sol: sol1 to sol7: a 9 px square centred on the middle of column k's coloured square (u c(k), z 3.785): the box [sx - 4, sy - 4, 9, 9]
rules.globos: the balloons: a 24 x 20 px stand-in whose foot (its bottom middle) is at the top of the board's left post (u -2.48, v -.07, z 4.4): the box [sx - 12, sy - 20, 24, 20]

wide.what: the one view of stories 69, 70 and 71: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture. The spec: every spot of every moment is inside it (a person with his sprite whole, a small thing with its box whole; entrada is outside on purpose). x0 18 to 25 hold them all; x0 22 is the one nearest 22, the window centred on the picture (the spots held span columns 25 to 213). The window's point is the ground point under its middle column at the picture's middle row

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the board's roof and posts, the seat, the lamps and the trees hide whoever is behind them.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where bakedZ[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias (bakedZ: window.DEPTH.z of the set page). The same rule as El cruce's sheet: the upright plane through the feet (a card on a hook is the plane through its top, on the board's face)
front.sprites: between two sprites the nearer pixel wins: the same depth(r), no bias; two planes within 0.001 are a tie and the later layer is drawn

shadows.at: castShadow(x, y, 0, radius) at the world x, y of the spot, for a character standing on the ground (z 0). The spec gives no radius: these are El cruce's (frog .45, grown-ups .35, children .28, the dog .3) (open point)
shadows.onSeat: whoever sits on the seat or stands on the step (z above 0) casts none: neither is ground (a shadow cast at the paving under them would show in front of them)
